brief.fact: Paradise & Wilderness says around 1,750 employees work within its group in Tanzania, with about 150 more in offices abroad.
brief.source_title: About us - meet our team - Paradise & Wilderness
brief.excerpt: Around 1,750 employees work within the Paradise & Wilderness Group in Tanzania, supported by approximately 150 additional employees in offices around the world.

brief.fact: Paradise & Wilderness operates 22 lodges, camps and beach resorts across mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar, and has operated in Tanzania since 2011.
brief.source_title: About us - meet our team - Paradise & Wilderness
brief.excerpt: The family business started in Europe in 1995 and has been operating in Tanzania since 2011. Today, Paradise & Wilderness operates a portfolio of 22 lodges, camps and beach resorts
